Text against the source: all captions and labels match source PAGE 9, including the separator '•' in 'Welbuk Practice • Welbuk Care • Welbuk Health'. The source uses '•' there, so the difference from the '·' on screen labels is a faithful copy, not an error. 'WELBUK VISION' appears on both 09-2 and 09-3, as the source requires future-vision scenes to be visibly labelled. Together with the pale-blue vignette, this keeps both panels from reading as launched features.

09-3 caption near Ravi's arm (checked against the art, 1536x528, scaled about 0.644): the caption box (about x 40-407, y 588-725) overlaps the outer edge of Ravi's right shoulder and upper sleeve. That strip runs from about x 362-378 to x 407 between y 617 and 725, so the box sits in front of a sliver of his shirt. His pointing hand and forearm (about x 469-572, y 675-700), his face (x 462-577) and the tablet (protected [583,681,159,103]) are all clear. Only a clothing silhouette is cut, not a face, hand or prop, so it is acceptable. Narrowing the box to about x 380 would remove the overlap and is optional polish.

09-4 label near Ravi's hair (checked against the art, 1280x800, scaled about 0.765): the right edge of his hair maps to about page x 702, and the label box starts at about x 704-705. It sits tangent to the hair without covering it, and his face box (ends at x 699) and raised waving hand (about x 596-636) are clear. The label overlaps the top of his far shoulder (about x 739-770, y 978-1008) and the awning. Acceptable.

In this full-length group shot no pavement band is free of feet, so any bottom caption would cover some feet. Acceptable. Moving the caption into the free area at lower left (x 30-315, left of Meera's legs) is possible optional polish but not required.

Other first-reader concerns: 09-1's caption box (ends at x 300) is clear of Ravi's chin hand and face (starting at x 313). In 09-2 the caption's top edge (y 322) sits below the specialist's welcoming hand (protected [672,262,74,54]), and 'connections' keeps about 20 px of padding inside the box. 'us/our' in 09-1 reads as the brand narrator, matching the closing caption 'Welbuk — Building...'; this wording is from the source, and the user kept the page. The specialist and family are framed as symbolic by the vignette and the label, as the source specifies.

The page turn to Ravi on a train with 'Tomorrow, care may take us beyond our hometown.' is a deliberate, conditional jump into the future, signalled by 'Tomorrow' and 'may'. This page is the user-retained vision page.
Ravi gazes out of the train window, then the WELBUK VISION label and pale-blue vignette show a clinic and specialist in another city. The window-gaze leads into the imagined destination.
The same vignette and label continue, widening to the family scene. Ravi's green shirt links him to the travel panel, and the dotted lines between clinics repeat at the left.

The vignette disappears and the scene returns to the present-day clinic entrance in full colour, with Meera, Ananya and Ravi in their usual clothes. The product label and closing caption end the comic.

readingReview.comparison: The first reading's order matches the intended order for 09-1 to 09-4 exactly, and there was no dialogue to skip. Its overlap concerns were checked against the panel art. 09-3: the caption cuts a sliver of Ravi's shoulder and sleeve, not his pointing arm or hand. 09-4: the label sits tangent to Ravi's hair without covering it. The bottom caption covers Meera's lower legs and feet and grazes Ananya's legging edge, but no face, hand or prop. I accept all three, with optional repositioning noted. The jump from page 8 to 'Tomorrow', the 'us/our' narrator, the repeated WELBUK VISION label and the '•' separator are all faithful to the source and to the user's decision to keep this page, and each is clearly signalled. They do not need changes.
